title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at $76,279—modest half-percent gain as we close out the session. Range-bound action, no dramatic swings.

Here's what matters: Fear & Greed at 32. That's pure fear territory. Investors are nervous, which historically creates opportunity, but conviction's low right now.
